verdict.rationale: Orrick is a law firm whose digital offerings are free self-service legal forms, document generators, health-check tools and client portals. A developer-style sandbox environment separate from production data is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows Orrick ships an API or platform with sandbox and production environments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
